name: klayson
description: Klayson's studio and brand guide in your agent: design ads, social posts and other marketing in your brand on Klayson's canvas, and read the brand guide (voice, logo, colors, type, imagery, products) so whatever your agent designs or builds, an ad, a website or a deck, follows the brand.

interface.shortDescription: Design in your brand, keep agents on it
interface.longDescription: Klayson is the studio where you design ads, social posts and other marketing for your brand, with Klayson's chat or with Codex, every design an editable frame on a Klayson canvas. It is also your brand's source of truth: each brand has a guide in eight sections (brand, voice, logo, color, typography, imagery, in use, products), read from your website or your PDF guide, and Codex reads it before it designs or builds anything for the brand. Needs a Klayson account: signing in for the first time makes one on the Free plan, with limited usage each month and no card.
defaultPrompt: Use Klayson to set up my brand and make my first 3 ads.
Read my brand guide from Klayson and follow it in this project.
Make 5 Instagram posts for our summer sale in my brand.
